challenge: Low user retention and drop-offs during cross-border money transfer setups due to complex multi-step forms and slow transaction status updates.
solution: Redesigned the onboarding workflow into modular, progressive steps and implemented background state synchronization to deliver instant visual feedback upon transfer completion.

challenge: High bounce rates on mobile devices caused by heavy static assets, poor initial page load speeds, and non-responsive layout scaling.
solution: Architected a modern landing page with Next.js static generation, automated WebP image optimizations, and responsive Tailwind layouts to achieve sub-second load times.
